% pgfmanual-en-tikz-paths.tex:396-398: the inset is not scaled.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \path[use as bounding box] (-3pt,-3pt) rectangle (95pt,38pt);
  \draw[blue,line width=1pt,rounded corners=8pt]
    (0pt,0pt) -- (0pt,22pt) -- (30pt,22pt);
  \begin{scope}[xshift=45pt,rotate=20,xscale=1.6,yscale=.7]
    \draw[red,line width=1pt,rounded corners=8pt]
      (0pt,0pt) -- (0pt,22pt) -- (30pt,22pt);
  \end{scope}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
